pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): Shocking evidence reveals the truth behind the Flannan Isles anomaly. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: An ancient maritime mystery might finally have a terrifying scientific explanation. In Part 1, we explored the vanishing lighthouse keepers of the Flannan Isles, but when investigators surveyed the island's western landing, they uncovered destruction that defied logic. Over one hundred feet above sea level, massive iron railings were twisted out of shape, concrete moorings were torn from solid rock, and a stone supply box weighing over a ton had been completely ripped away. Modern oceanographers believe a freak oceanic phenomenon called a rogue wave hit the cliffs without warning. If two keepers were caught near the cliff edge, the third likely rushed out without his coat to help, only for a second monstrous wave to sweep all three men into the deep ocean forever.
